evidence.FACTS: Removed the 'méthode de la plateforme', 'aucune disponibilité garantie' formulas, the stacked claims about 'flottes hanoïennes' (minority share of manuals), 'réserver tôt, les manuelles se trouvent plus vite complètes' (unsourced stock claim), and the contract-line list presented as a standard (caution et sa forme, assistance, zone). Prices: no rate quoted for manual/sport bikes (protocol); the page says explicitly that no indicative rate is published and that availability/caution/assurance/zone are to be confirmed once, in the reservation section. Legal: Law 36/2024/QH15 in force 1 Jan 2025, A1 up to 125 cm3 and A above, same wording and same government-portal source as the rewritten hub /types-motos/ (source reused, not re-opened in this session); explicit statement that licence validity depends on national licence/country/IDP and that travel insurance may set its own conditions. Model names (Winner X, Exciter 155, WR155R) used only as examples of clutch bikes with 'se constate sur l'exemplaire' qualifier; no spec figure. NAP and hours (09:00-21:00, 0334 699 969, Zalo/WhatsApp, Ngõ 5 Nguyễn Văn Cừ, Bồ Đề, Long Biên, near Bến xe Gia Lâm) used once.

evidence.CONTENT: Full rewrite.
